title: S-EDL: Eliciting Self-Evidence from Sequence Likelihoods for Semantic Calibration of LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.29832v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Calibrating large language models (LLMs) in open-ended generation is uniquely challenging because many distinct token sequences can express the same underlying meaning. Prior calibration techniques target either fixed-set classification confidence or the binary correctness of individual strings, making them inherently ill-suited for the dynamic, multi-string nature of open-ended semantic outcomes. To bridge this gap, we introduce S-EDL, a novel evidential method that natively optimizes LLMs for semantic calibration. By eliciting evidence from the sequence likelihoods of the model itself, S-EDL constructs a differentiable Dirichlet prior over prompt-specific semantic classes. Optimizing the evidential loss under this prior yields a calibration-aware training signal over variable semantic classes, completely bypassing the need for fixed multiple-choice options. translated_title: S-EDL：从序列似然中引出自证据以实现大语言模型的语义校准
translated_abstract: 在开放式生成中对大语言模型（LLM）进行校准具有独特的挑战性，因为许多不同的token序列可以表达相同的底层含义。先前的校准技术要么针对固定集合的分类置信度，要么针对单个字符串的二元正确性，这使它们本质上不适合开放式语义结果的动态、多字符串特性。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了S-EDL，这是一种新颖的证据学习方法，能够原生地针对语义校准来优化LLM。通过从模型自身的序列似然中引出证据，S-EDL在特定提示的语义类上构建了一个可微分的Dirichlet先验。在该先验下优化证据损失，可以在可变语义类上产生感知校准的训练信号，从而完全无需固定的多项选择选项。在四个开放式基准测试和三个模型上的评估表明
tldr: 提出S-EDL证据学习方法，通过从模型自身的序列似然中引出证据并构建可微分的Dirichlet先验，实现了LLM在开放式生成中的语义校准，完全无需依赖固定的多项选择选项。
en_tdlr: S-EDL is a novel evidential method that elicits self-evidence from a model's own sequence likelihoods to construct a differentiable Dirichlet prior over semantic classes, enabling semantic calibration of LLMs in open-ended generation without requiring fixed multiple-choice options.
